description: Ministry of Water Supply - Construction of Siyambalagasruppa 1500 m3 Water Tower Bingiriya Udubaddawa Water Supply Project, Waragolla Ground Reservoir and Access Road of Hasalaka, acquisition of lands by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board for the laying of Pipe Lines in Matale area of Greater Matale Water Supply Projects
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders from the Minister of Water Supply approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, their boundaries, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, the core content focuses on land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
